title: Token-latency sampler and KV-prefetch observability fabric for multi-region failover
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a sampled token-level latency telemetry fabric that ties admit-score, KV cache prefetch/hit, and sequence priority to regional failover triggers and circuit-breaker state. The goal is to produce an attachable telemetry layer that provides high-fidelity token latency SLIs without overwhelming ingestion costs, enables correlation between KV-prefetch behavior and tail latency, and surfaces actionable signals for runtime control planes and the Console dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Producer: a sampling library embedded in the ingress path that emits one sampled token trace per sequence with metadata (admit_score, shard, region, kv_prefetch_tag, sequence_priority)
Telemetry: exported metrics/OTLP traces + a lightweight per-tenant sampling config (rate, reservoir size, priority buckets) configurable from Console
Dashboards: Console dashboard panels that correlate sampled token p50/p95/p99 with kv_prefetch hit/miss ratios and admit_score bands, filterable by region and model version
Failover integration: an alert rule and playbook that triggers when sampled tail latency + kv-miss spike exceeds threshold and circuit-breaker is in at-risk state
Cost: sampling strategy must reduce ingestion volume by >= 90% vs full-token capture for same tenant traffic profile
tasks: Design sampling reservoir algorithm and priority bucketing (Spike-resistant reservoir + per-tenant quotas)
Implement ingress instrumentation hook to tag traces with kv_prefetch metadata and admit_score
Add config endpoints in control plane for per-tenant sampling policies
Wire OTLP exporter and metric derivations for token p50/p95/p99 aggregated from samples
Build Console panels: token-latency vs kv-prefetch, admit_score corridor, regional failover correlation
Add automated synthetic probe to validate end-to-end pipeline and playbook binding
comments: 2026-03-05 - Asha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes attached in Confluence. Decided to prefer reservoir sampling over periodic sampling to preserve burst visibility.

2026-03-10 - Miguel Santos: Implemented OTLP exporter + local test harness. End-to-end test shows 12x reduction in event count with preserved p99 signal in synthetic burst test.
